# Maxnova & Luci Global

> MAXNOVA & LUCI GLOBAL LLC is a Florida limited liability company that builds and operates software products, and offers consulting based on that experience. It also operates from Chile.

## Operating companies
- [DypOS](https://www.dypos.app): software for restaurants (point of sale, kitchen, inventory, monthly P&L). Live, Latin America.
- [MOY IQ](https://moyiq.app): personal finance app with an IQ Score from 0 to 100; no bank login required. Live, United States and Latin America.
- [Esmalia](https://esmalia.com): software for dental clinics (WhatsApp appointment confirmations, patient chart, odontogram). Live in Chile, Peru, Mexico, Colombia and Argentina.
- Amazon FBA: Seller Central Professional account selling in the United States. Active.
- A healthcare practice product is in development and not yet public.

## Consulting services
Quoted per project after a diagnostic call; no public prices.
- AI software and SaaS development
- US market entry: Florida LLC, US banking, Stripe and platform accounts
- Amazon FBA and e-commerce
- Telecom and sourcing from China
